sectors.name: 01 / WEST CHECKPOINT
sectors.description: Search booths, stalled convoy, armoured gate. The central road is exposed.

sectors.name: 02 / CUSTOMS RECORDS
sectors.description: Records rooms and dispatch desk. Three entrances connect the rail path and checkpoint.

sectors.name: 03 / NORTH RAIL SIDINGS
sectors.description: Three sidings and cargo gaps. A long sightline competes with the outer treeline.

sectors.name: 04 / FREIGHT COMPLEX
sectors.description: Through-warehouse circulation, independent inspection bay, two receiving sheds.

sectors.name: 05 / FUEL + SUBSTATION
sectors.description: Tank pockets, switchgear and control room. Barrel aisles break up the industrial apron.

sectors.name: 06 / WORKERS QUARTERS
sectors.description: Two dormitories, a ration shop and a canteen. Courtyards and alleys connect the southern bypass.

sectors.name: 07 / EVACUATION CLINIC
sectors.description: Open triage yard and two clinic wings. Multiple doorways prevent a single-entry dead end.

sectors.name: 08 / MOTOR POOL
sectors.description: Repair bays, stalled vehicles and a parts yard. Wide garage entries connect both flanks.
sectors.design_interest: Tools / vehicle cover / long east flank

sectors.name: 09 / DRAINAGE BYPASS
sectors.description: Two bridges over the drainage trench, a pump house and a service-exit approach.
